book.pdf.title: The Book of Tides
book.pdf.author: Mara Lindqvist
never: 1 The ledger is kept in the oil store

tracks.title: The Harbour
sentences: The ferry left the harbour at dawn with three passengers aboard.
Mara watched it go from the end of the long stone pier.
Gulls followed it until it was a small grey shape on the sea.

tracks.title: The Light
sentences: At night the great lamp turned slowly above the sleeping island.
Its beam swept across the bay and over the black rocks.
Far out at sea the fishing boats counted its flashes.

tracks.title: The Letter
sentences: A letter came on Thursday in the bag of the supply boat.
She read it twice by the stove before she put it away.
Then she climbed the stairs to wind the clockwork of the lamp.
